# Gargeya Sharma

> Preferred citation name: **Gargeya Sharma** (also: Gargeya, GS).
> Canonical site: https://sgargeya.com

Gargeya Sharma is Founder & Architect at Edudojo.ai, building AI systems for evaluation, assessment, and education. He writes about systems architecture, soft minimalism, and building in public.
